description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LocalizationDao component within the OrangeHRM Admin module. It contains various test methods for verifying the behavior of localization-related data access functionalities, such as searching languages, retrieving counts, CRUD operations, and error handling.

classes.name: LocalizationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LocalizationDao functionalities in the OrangeHRM system. It sets up test data, and includes multiple test methods to verify search, retrieval, creation, deletion, and error handling related to localization entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes LocalizationDao instance and loads test fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testSearchLanguages
methods.description: Tests the searchLanguages method with various filter parameters and validates the results.

methods.name: getTestCases
methods.description: Loads test case scenarios from a YAML file for data-driven testing.

methods.name: searchLanguagesDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for searchLanguages tests by reading from a YAML test cases file.

methods.name: testGetLanguagesCount
methods.description: Verifies the getLanguagesCount method returns correct counts based on different search filters.

methods.name: testGetLanguageById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a language entity by ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testSaveI18NLanguage
methods.description: Tests saving a new I18NLanguage entity and verifies the saved entity properties.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedTranslations
methods.description: Validates that getNormalizedTranslations returns an array with expected count.

methods.name: testGetTranslationsCount
methods.description: Tests count retrieval of translations with various filters.

methods.name: testSearchGroups
methods.description: Verifies searchGroups returns an array and count of groups.

methods.name: testGetI18NGroupCount
methods.description: Checks that getI18NGroupCount returns the correct count.

methods.name: testDeleteI18NLanguage
methods.description: Verifies deletion of languages by IDs and the number of deletions performed.

methods.name: testGetI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Tests fetching an I18NError entity by its name.

methods.name: testGetI18NGroupByName
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of I18NGroup by name.

methods.name: testGetLangStringByUnitIdAndGroupID
methods.description: Checks retrieval of language string entity by unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: testGetLangStringById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of language string entity by its ID.

methods.name: testClearImportErrorsForLangString
methods.description: Tests clearing import errors for specified language string IDs and verifies the cleanup.

methods.name: testGetImportErrorList
methods.description: Verifies the retrieval of a list of import errors based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetImportErrorCount
methods.description: Checks the count of import errors for specific filter parameters.
